content.comment_body: I recently purchased the starter kit and received all necessary license codes, but I don't have a CD/DVD drive since the package still includes a DVD. It's hard to believe they still use DVDs—haven’t used one since 2003. I only see updates for the full version available online. Is there any way to download the full version and activate it with my license?
Do you have a DVD disc? Consider buying an external USB DVD drive.
If you bought the starter kit, how come you don’t have a CD/DVD? When did you buy it? With [product_name] software, the physical CD/DVD itself acts as the license, not a separate code.

Who still owns a DVD drive in 2020? I haven’t used one in about a decade. They should ship the software on a USB drive instead of outdated media. Anyway, now I know—think old school, think [company_name]. Thanks for your response!

If you haven’t used a CD/DVD since 2010, that's impressive! But blaming [company_name] for this feels misplaced—maybe by 2025 they'll send licenses telepathically. It’s always better to adapt to new media. Biontech, for example, keeps up.
I don’t know anyone who has used DVDs in the last decade. Where I live, you basically can’t even buy them anymore. Thanks for the history lesson!
You can easily buy an inexpensive USB DVD drive online or at a local IT shop.

It's true—many new laptops and desktop computers don't come with a disc drive; the only thing spinning is a fan. For Windows, SolidWorks, Inventor, you normally download directly from the provider for the latest version. [url] I think that link will work for downloading [product_name] [version_no].
No, you can only download upgrades online. Full versions of [product_name] are provided only on CD/DVD.
Sorry I didn’t notice before, but I always had an old version installed on my computer when doing upgrades.

I thought working with AB software was tough, but this experience with [company_name] [product_name] PLC is probably my last. The advice here is disappointing—criticizing someone for not having a DVD drive isn’t helpful. [company_name] makes technical products but lags behind in software distribution due to their concerns about piracy. Competing companies allow online downloads, which boosts their market share.
Are you posting just to vent your frustration? Forums are meant for users helping each other; if you want to complain, contact [company_name] support directly.
This forum has really helped me. Keep up the good work.
Is it still only possible to get [product_name] on DVD/CD-ROM? Where can you download the full version?
There isn’t a download for the full version. You still need to purchase the full version.

Seriously? It's 2023 and you charge for essential software to use the PLC I bought from you? I’m returning your product to get something from another company that doesn’t try to overcharge for software.

[company_name] isn’t trying to take advantage of customers. If you already have an older full version installed or an installation CD/DVD, you can download a free upgrade to the newest [product_name] version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face significant frustration obtaining the full version of [product_name] after purchasing a starter kit because the software is still distributed exclusively on CD/DVD. The lack of modern options like USB or direct online download and activation negatively affects usability. Most users are surprised [company_name] continues with outdated distribution, especially since other companies provide online downloads.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily download the complete software package online and activate it using the license codes provided with their starter kit, aligning with current software distribution practices.
